summary: Backend-only verification for new public privacy policy endpoint and regression. Added /app/backend/tests/test_privacy.py (3 tests) covering: (1) GET /api/privacy returns 200 with text/html; (2) body contains title 'Contas em Dia — Política de Privacidade' (em dash via —) plus required sections (dados, LGPD, contato); (3) endpoint is public — works with no auth header AND ignores invalid bearer token. Also re-ran existing /app/backend/tests/test_contas_em_dia.py (auth, bills CRUD, PATCH /paid recurring+non-recurring, backup export/import, validation). All 14/14 tests PASSED. Verified via public HTTPS URL (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL) directly with curl: HTTP 200, Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8, 2658 bytes, h1='Contas em Dia — Política de Privacidade', sections present (Quais dados coletamos, Seus direitos (LGPD), Contato, etc.).

minor.issue: The <title> HTML tag uses a plain hyphen ('Contas em Dia - Política de Privacidade') while the <h1> uses an em dash via —. Cosmetic only — the user-visible page title (H1) matches the spec. Consider aligning the <title> tag to also use em dash for consistency. Reference: /app/backend/routers/legal.py:8

action_items: (Optional, cosmetic) Change the <title> tag in /app/backend/routers/legal.py from a hyphen to '—' so it matches the H1 and the deployment agent's expected public privacy policy title exactly.
critical_code_review_comments: legal.py is clean: single public route under /api prefix, HTMLResponse with correct charset, no DB access, no auth coupling — appropriate for a store-listing privacy URL.
server.py correctly mounts the legal router under the /api prefix (required for Kubernetes ingress routing).
No ObjectId leakage, no hardcoded URLs, no env-variable misuse.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests register ephemeral TEST_* users and clean them up via DELETE /api/auth/me.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Privacy endpoint is live at https://vencimentos-1.preview.emergentagent.com/api/privacy (public, no auth). Full backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/ with pytest.ini configured; run `pytest backend/tests/ -v` from /app. Env read from /app/frontend/.env (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL).
